plan.title: Shared memory pilot: token validation
plan.goal: Hand over one real task Codex → Claude → fresh Codex, preserving the goal, state, sources and evidence outside the conversation history.
constraints: Work only in the registered devbrain-pilot repository.
Python 3 and the standard library; no external dependencies or network services in the task implementation.
The function token_auth.validate_token(token) must return a bool: True only for the string 'valid', False for any other input; it does not raise an exception for values of other types.
Codex leaves needs_test; Claude runs the named unit profile and a separate review; a fresh Codex restores the result from the shared memory.
Save pilot reports and logs outside the worktree, in the directory given by DEVBRAIN_PILOT_REPORT_DIR.

steps.content: Implement token_auth.validate_token(token), write unittest tests, then run the unit profile and a review that records each criterion. Hand over the state through DevBrain between fresh clients.

acceptance_criteria: token_auth.py exposes validate_token(token); for the string 'valid' the result is exactly True.
Other strings, including the empty string, 'invalid', 'VALID', ' valid' and 'valid ', return exactly False.
None, integers, bool values, bytes, lists and dicts return exactly False without raising an exception.

tests/test_token_auth.py contains at least 12 unittest test_* methods covering the cases above; the reviewer checks the actual assertions and a positive number of executed tests in the stdout/stderr logs.
The current task definition and code have a fresh, successful result from a real unit profile run; a separate review record lists the assessment of each criterion.
